en.plugins.sticker.desc: Create a sticker from a photo or a short video (10 seconds max)
en.plugins.sticker.reply_required: ❌ Reply to a photo or a short video (10 seconds max) with {0}sticker, or send one with the command as caption.
en.plugins.sticker.already_sticker: ❌ That message is already a sticker. Reply to a photo or a short video instead.
en.plugins.sticker.too_big: ❌ The sticker is still too heavy after compression. Try a shorter or simpler video.
en.plugins.sticker.error: ❌ Couldn't create the sticker. The file may be corrupted or in an unsupported format.
